issues.criterion: NF10-roots,NF10-bytes bounded traversal and resource overflow
issues.evidence: host_input_contract.bounds limits file count, file bytes and depth, but has no total traversal-entry/directory count. A selected package containing arbitrarily many empty directories at permitted depth can require unbounded enumeration while remaining within every declared file and byte bound. File-count limit alone does not bound this case.
issues.required_fix: Declare a finite total visited-entry or directory-count bound including empty directories and reject overflow without truncating assessed scope. Add a discriminating empty-directory/entry fan-out negative to isolated-containment-suite and a bounded valid directory-tree control.

required_fixes: Bound total traversal entries/directories, including empty directories, and map the overflow control to the existing boundary suite.
observations: The trusted programmatic verifier and default no-verifier CLI now establish the right boundary: untrusted JSON cannot select code/trust or assert accepted=true; exact trusted released-catalogue/package/framework binding is testable.
Verified and unreleased recommended entries cannot activate offers, even when local bytes and synthetic trusted qualification match.
Canonical Nizam host digest over actual assessed bytes is distinct from DS inventory identity; unknown DS mapping remains unverified. No neutral DS format or package qualification is invented.
Descriptor no-follow walks, before/after identity and exact-set checks, symlink/race/hardlink/special-file negatives and unsafe mutants are explicitly mapped to meaningful dedicated isolation tests.

Same-byte hashing necessarily reads selected-package entrypoint bytes for integrity; the no-body-loading rule should mean no parsing, disclosure or agent-context loading of those bodies, while only deliberately selected host entrypoints may be loaded for use.

Before implementation, Orchestrator must record actual distinct role identities, accepted NF05/NF09 prerequisites and capability preflight; unsupported host capabilities must remain honest and fail closed.

final_verdict.summary: Revision 2 closes trust, activation and host-identity ambiguity. One bounded-traversal gap remains: arbitrarily many empty directories escape all declared resource limits.

limitations: Contract testability review only; no source implementation, actual DS artifacts, compatibility qualification, behavioral evaluation or release approval.
